section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study investigating body appreciation in men across sexual orientations. The study found that body appreciation is inversely correlated with conformity to masculine norms and upward appearance-based social comparisons, and positively related to physical activity. The research used a community sample (more diverse than prior university-based studies) and found that sexual minority men reported lower body appreciation than heterosexual men, with this relationship mediated by athletic appearance-ideal internalisation and upward appearance-based social comparisons.
